3400k.name: 3400 K
3400k.description: A documented surrogate for the undocumented, display-dependent warmest macOS Night Shift setting. This is the least destructive profile in the set.

2000k.name: 2000 K
2000k.target: Redshift 2000 K with reset ramps, brightness 1, gamma 1
2000k.description: The pinned Redshift 2000 K gamma-ramp signal transform with identity input ramps, unit brightness, and unit per-channel gamma.

1200k.name: 1200 K
1200k.target: Redshift 1200 K with reset ramps, brightness 1, gamma 1
1200k.description: The pinned Redshift 1200 K signal-LUT transform: blue is removed and green is heavily attenuated. This is a severe visibility stress test, not a claim of physical astronomy safety.
